전체 소스 위치 보기

현재 작성 자료가 참조하는 정규 원본이다. SDK와 프로젝트별 framework 중복 사본은 제외했다. 각 줄의 링크는 HTML 안의 실제 원문 줄을 가리킨다.

124         auto& scene = app.getScene(); 125         if (!id) return false; 126         const auto* component = scene.getComponent(*id); 127         if (!component) return false; 128         auto value = component->transform; 129         MotionAction action; 130         switch (command.operation) { 131         case CuboidOperation::Position: action = SceneActions::position(scene, *id, command.value); break; 132         case CuboidOperation::Translate: 133             action = SceneActions::position(scene, *id, value.basis + command.value); break; 134         case CuboidOperation::Rotate: { 135             const auto rotation = TransformSystem::rotation({glm::vec3(0), command.value}, command.degrees); 136             if (!rotation) return false; 137             value.rotation = value.rotation * glm::mat3(*rotation); 138             action = SceneActions::transform(scene, *id, value); break; 139         } 140         case CuboidOperation::Scale: action = SceneActions::scale(scene, *id, command.value); break; 141         case CuboidOperation::Transform: action = SceneActions::transform(scene, *id, command.transform); break; 142         case CuboidOperation::Pivot: action = SceneActions::pivot(scene, *id, command.value); break; 143         case CuboidOperation::Visible: action = SceneActions::visible(scene, *id, command.enabled); break; 144         case CuboidOperation::ToggleVisible: action = SceneActions::visible(scene, *id, !component->visible); break; 145         case CuboidOperation::Layer: action = SceneActions::layer(scene, *id, command.layer); break; 146         case CuboidOperation::Motion: { 147             const auto layer = scene.getEntityLayer(*id); 148             return layer && scene.getMotions().bindMotion(*layer, command.motion); 149         } 150         case CuboidOperation::Playing: { 151             const auto layer = scene.getEntityLayer(*id); 152             const auto* state = layer ? scene.getMotions().getLayer(*layer) : nullptr; 153             return state && state->config.motion && scene.getMotions().setMotionPlaying(*state->config.motion, command.enabled); 154         } 155         default: return false; 156         } 157         return action(0, MotionSample{}); 158     }; 159 } 160 bool bindCuboidMode(Application& app, std::shared_ptr<CuboidMode> mode) { 161     if (!mode) return false; 162     app.setInitHandler([mode](Application& app) { return mode->apply(app); }); 163     app.setUpdateHandler([mode](Application& app, float dt) { 164         if (!mode->update(app, dt)) app.requestClose(); 165     }); 166     app.setModifiedKeyHandler([mode](Application& app, int key, int action, int mods) { 167         if (!mode->dispatch(app, key, action, mods)) app.requestClose(); 168     }); 169     return true; 170 } 171 } // namespace graphics

198     }; 199 } 200  201 PathFunction PathSystem::polygon(std::vector<glm::vec3> points) { 202     return polyline(std::move(points), true); 203 } 204  205 PathFunction PathSystem::rectangle(const glm::vec3& center, const glm::vec3& u, const glm::vec3& v) { 206     if (!detail::finiteVector(center) || !detail::motionPlane(u, v)) 207         return ( 208             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PathSystem::rectangle", 209                                 "Rejected condition: !detail::finiteVector(center) || !detail::motionPlane(u, v)", 210                                 "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), 211             PathFunction{}); 212  213     const auto a = detail::motionUnitVector(u), b = detail::motionUnitVector(v); 214  215     if (std::abs(glm::dot(*a, *b)) > 1e-5f) 216         return ( 217             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "PathSystem::rectangle", 218                                 "Rejected condition: std::abs(glm::dot(*a, *b)) > 1e-5f", 219                                 "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."), 220             PathFunction{}); 221  222     return polygon({center - u - v, center + u - v, center + u + v, center - u + v}); 223 } 224  225 double PathSystem::linear(double progress) { 226     return progress; 227 } 228  229 double PathSystem::smoothStep(double progress) { 230     return progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress); 231 } 232 } // namespace graphics

std::filesystem::u8path(argv[3]) : std::filesystem::path{};  24     graphics::ApplicationConfig config;  25   26     config.projectRoot = ".";  27     config.features.textures = !texturePath.empty();  28   29     graphics::Application app;  30   31     app.setInitHandler([&](graphics::Application& app) {  32         graphics::LoadOptions options;  33   34         options.outline = graphics::OutlineMode::FeatureEdges;  35         options.texturePath = texturePath;  36   37         const auto loaded = app.getAssets().loadObj(path, options);  38   39         if (!loaded)  40             return false; // loadObj already printed the error and format guidance.  41   42         for (const auto& warning : loaded.warnings)  43             std::cerr << warning << '\n';  44   45         return app.getScene()  46             .addModel(*loaded.model, graphics::Transform3D{}, loaded.pivotMode, loaded.localBasis)  47             .has_value();  48     });  49     app.setMouseHandler([](graphics::Application& app, const graphics::MouseEvent& event) {  50         if (event.button == GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT && event.action == GLFW_PRESS)  51             if (const auto hit = app.pickAtCursor())  52                 std::cout << "entity=" << hit->entityId << " mesh=" << hit->faceIndex  53                           << " triangle=" << hit->triangleIndex << '\n';  54     });  55     app.setKeyHandler([](graphics::Application& app, int key, int action) {  56         if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE && action == GLFW_PRESS)  57             app.requestClose();  58     });  59   60     return app.run(config);  61 }

   1 #include "../Framework.h"   2 #include <iostream>   3    4 int main() {   5     using namespace graphics;   6    7     Application app;   8     std::optional<MotionId> pathId, spinId, globalId;   9     std::optional<LayerId> mirrorLayer, normalSpinLayer, insertedLayer;  10     bool paused = false, spinEnabled = true, globalEnabled = false;  11     int reflection = 1;  12   13     const auto choosePath = [&](int kind) {  14         PathMotion path;  15   16         path.durationSeconds = 6;  17   18         const glm::vec3 center(1.7f, 0, 0);  19   20         if (kind == 1)  21             path.path = PathSystem::ellipse(center, {.8f, 0, 0}, {0, .5f, 0});  22         else if (kind == 2)  23             path.path = PathSystem::rectangle(center, {.8f, 0, 0}, {0, .5f, 0});  24         else if (kind == 3)  25             path.path =  26                 PathSystem::polygon({{1, -.5f, 0}, {2.4f, -.4f, 0}, {2.1f, .6f, 0}, {1.4f, .8f, 0}, {.9f, .2f, 0}});  27         else if (kind == 4) {  28             path.path = [center](double u) {  29                 const double angle = u * 6.283185307179586;  30   31                 return center + glm::vec3(float(.7 * std::sin(2 * angle)), float(.6 * std::sin(angle)),  32                                           float(.3 * std::cos(angle)));  33             };  34             path.interpolation = PathSystem::smoothStep;  35         } else if (kind == 5)  36             path.path = PathSystem::circle(center, .65f, {0, 0, 1});  37         else {  38             path.path = PathSystem::polyline({{1, -.5f, 0}, {2.4f, -.5f, 0}, {2, .6f, 0}});  39             path.playback = Playback::PingPong;  40         }  41   42         Motion motion;  43         auto& motions = app.getScene().getMotions();  44   45         return pathId && motion.append(Motion::followPath(path)) && motions.setMotion(*pathId, motion) &&  46                motions.seekMotion(*pathId, 0);  47     };  48   49     app.setInitHandler([&](Application& current) {  50         auto& scene = current.getScene();  51         auto& motions = scene.getMotions();  52         const auto first = scene.addCuboid({.4f, .6f, .3f}, {0, 0, 0});  53         const auto second = scene.addCuboid({.4f, .6f, .3f}, {0, 0, 0});  54   55         if (!first || !second)  56             return false;  57   58         if (!scene.setTint(*first, {1, .35f, .2f}) || !scene.setTint(*second, {.2f, .7f, 1}))  59             return false;  60         pathId = motions.createMotion(Motion{});  61   62         RotationMotion spin;  63   64         spin.degreesPerSecond = 90;  65         spinId = motions.createSpin(spin);  66   67         RotationMotion global;  68   69         global.degreesPerSecond = 15;  70         globalId = motions.createOrbit(global);  71   72         if (!pathId || !spinId || !globalId || !choosePath(1))  73             return false;  74   75         if (!motions.setMotionEnabled(*globalId, false) || !motions.bindMotion(MotionSystem::rootLayer(), *globalId))  76             return false;  77   78         const auto normalPath = motions.pushLayer(MotionSystem::rootLayer());  79         const auto reflectionMatrix = TransformSystem::reflectPlane({0, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0});  80   81         if (!normalPath || !reflectionMatrix)  82             return false;  83   84         LayerConfig mirror;  85   86         mirror.transform = *reflectionMatrix;  87         mirrorLayer = motions.pushLayer(MotionSystem::rootLayer(), mirror);  88   89         if (!mirrorLayer)  90             return false;  91   92         const auto mirroredPath = motions.pushLayer(*mirrorLayer);  93   94         normalSpinLayer = motions.pushLayer(*normalPath);  95   96         if (!mirroredPath || !normalSpinLayer)  97             return false;  98   99         const auto mirroredSpin = motions.pushLayer(*mirroredPath); 100  101         if (!mirroredSpin || !motions.bindMotion(*normalPath, *pathId) || !motions.bindMotion(*mirroredPath, *pathId) || 102             !motions.bindMotion(*normalSpinLayer, *spinId) || !motions.bindMotion(*mirroredSpin, *spinId) || 103             !scene.bindEntity(*first, *normalSpinLayer) || !scene.bindEntity(*second, *mirroredSpin)) 104             return false; 105  106         if (!scene.addBasis({0, 0, 0}, glm::mat3(1), {.55f, .55f, .55f}, *first) || 107             !scene.addBasis({0, 0, 0}, glm::mat3(1), {.55f, .55f, .55f}, *second) || 108             !scene.addLine({0, -1.4f, 0}, {0, 1.4f, 0}, {.5f, .5f, .5f})) 109             return false; 110         current.getCamera().position = {5, 3, 8}; 111         std::cout << "1 타원, 2 사각형, 3 다각형, 4 사용자 경로+보간, 5 원, 6 왕복 꺾은선\n" 112                   << "Space 시간 정지/재개, S 자전 표시, G 전체 공전, M 반사 변경, I 레이어 삽입/삭제\n" 113                   << "M: 없음 -> YZ평면 반사 -> 점대칭 -> Y직선 대칭 순환. 클릭: 객체 ID. Esc 종료\n"; 114  115         return true; 116     }); 117     app.setKeyHandler([&](Application& current, int key, int action) { 118         if (action != GLFW_PRESS) 119             return; 120  121         auto& motions = current.getScene().getMotions(); 122         bool ok = true; 123  124         if (key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) 125             current.requestClose(); 126         else if (key >= GLFW_KEY_1 && key <= GLFW_KEY_6) 127             ok = choosePath(key - GLFW_KEY_1 + 1); 128         else if (key == GLFW_KEY_SPACE) { 129             paused = !paused; 130             ok = motions.setMotionPlaying(*pathId, !paused) && motions.setMotionPlaying(*spinId, !paused) && 131                  motions.setMotionPlaying(*globalId, !paused); 132         } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_S) { 133             spinEnabled = !spinEnabled; 134             ok = motions.setMotionEnabled(*spinId, spinEnabled); 135         } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_G) { 136             globalEnabled = !globalEnabled; 137             ok = motions.setMotionEnabled(*globalId, globalEnabled); 138         } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_M) { 139             reflection = (reflection + 1) % 4; 140  141             std::optional<glm::mat4> matrix = glm::mat4(1); 142  143             if (reflection == 1) 144                 matrix = TransformSystem::reflectPlane({0, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0}); 145  146             if (reflection == 2) 147                 matrix = TransformSystem::reflectPoint({0, 0, 0}); 148  149             if (reflection == 3) 150                 matrix = TransformSystem::reflectLine(AxisLine{}); 151  152             LayerConfig config; 153  154             if (!matrix) 155                 ok = false; 156             else { 157                 config.transform = *matrix; 158                 ok = motions.setLayer(*mirrorLayer, config); 159             } 160         } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_I) { 161             if (insertedLayer) { 162                 ok = motions.removeLayer(*insertedLayer); 163  164                 if (ok) 165                     insertedLayer.reset(); 166             } else { 167                 LayerConfig config; 168  169                 config.space = TransformSpace::Local; 170  171                 const auto scale = TransformSystem::scaling(glm::vec3(1.5f)); 172  173                 if (!scale) 174                     ok = false; 175                 else { 176                     config.transform = *scale; 177                     insertedLayer = motions.insertLayer(*normalSpinLayer, config); 178                     ok = insertedLayer.has_value(); 179                 } 180             } 181         } 182  183         if (!ok) 184             current.requestClose(); 185     }); 186     app.setMouseHandler([](Application& current, const MouseEvent& event) { 187         if (event.button != GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT || event.action != GLFW_PRESS) 188             return; 189  190         const auto hit = current.pickAt(event.windowX, event.windowY); 191  192         if (hit) 193             std::cout << "entity=" << hit->entityId << " face=" << hit->faceIndex << '\n'; 194     }); 195  196     ApplicationConfig config; 197  198     config.title = "Motion and layer tree"; 199  200     return app.run(config); 201 }

};  42     }  43     static MotionAction faceVisible(Scene& scene, EntityId id, std::size_t face, bool value) {  44         return [&scene, id, face, value](double, const MotionSample&) { return scene.setFaceVisible(id, face, value);  49         };  50     }  51     static MotionAction motion(Scene& scene, LayerId layer, std::optional<MotionId> value) {  52         return [&scene, layer, value](double, const MotionSample&) { return scene.getMotions().bindMotion(layer, value);   9   10 struct DiagnosticOptions {  11     bool errors = true;  12     bool trace = false;  13 };  14   15 struct Diagnostic {  16     PipelineStage stage = PipelineStage::Runtime;  17     std::string api, cause, action;  18     std::optional<std::uint64_t> object;  19     std::string file, operation;  20     int line = 0;  21 };  22   23 class Diagnostics {  24     static DiagnosticOptions& options() {  25         static DiagnosticOptions value;  26   27         return value;  28     }  29   30     static std::optional<Diagnostic>& issue() {  31         static std::optional<Diagnostic> value;  32   33         return value;  34     }  35   36 public:  37     /// [API] 진단에 첨부할 현재 파일·줄·호출 경로 문맥의 참조를 반환한다.  38     static Diagnostic& context() {  39         static Diagnostic value;  40   41         return value;  42     }  43   44     /// [API] 다음 진단에 사용할 소스 파일·줄 번호·호출 경로를 설정한다.  45     static void locate(const char* file, int line, const char* operation) {  46         context().file = file;  47         context().line = line;  48         context().operation = operation;  49     }  50   51     /// [API] 주어진 소스 위치와 API 오류를 기록·출력하고 이전 진단 문맥을 복원한 뒤 false를 반환한다.  52     static bool failAt(const char* file, int line, PipelineStage stage, const char* api, const std::string& cause,  53                        const std::string& action = "소스 위치와 해당 API의 입력 조건을 확인하세요.",  54                        std::optional<std::uint64_t> object = std::nullopt) {  55         const auto saved = context();  56   57         locate(file, line, api);  58   59         if (!saved.operation.empty())  60             context().operation = saved.operation + " -> " + api;  61   62         const bool result = fail(stage, api, cause, action, object);  63   64         context() = saved;  65   66         return result;  67     }  68   69     /// [API] 파이프라인 단계 열거값에 대응하는 로그용 문자열을 반환한다.  70     static const char* stageName(PipelineStage stage) {  71         switch (stage) {  72         case PipelineStage::Runtime:  73             return "runtime";  74         case PipelineStage::Input:  75             return "input";  76         case PipelineStage::Scene:  77             return "scene";  78         case PipelineStage::Motion:  79             return "motion";  80         case PipelineStage::VertexInput:  81             return "vertex-input";  82         case PipelineStage::Shader:  83             return "shader";  84         case PipelineStage::Transform:  85             return "transform";  86         case PipelineStage::Raster:  87             return "raster";  88         case PipelineStage::Framebuffer:  89             return "framebuffer";  90         case PipelineStage::Asset:  91             return "asset";  92         }  93   94         return "알 수 없음";  95     }  96   97     /// [API] 오류 출력과 단계 추적 출력의 사용 여부를 설정한다.  98     static void configure(DiagnosticOptions value) {  99         options() = value; 100     } 101  102     /// [API] 마지막으로 기록한 오류의 optional 참조를 반환한다. 103     static const std::optional<Diagnostic>& lastError() { 104         return issue(); 105     } 106  107     /// [API] 마지막 오류 기록을 지운다. 진단 설정과 현재 위치 문맥은 유지한다. 108     static void clear() { 109         issue().reset(); 110     } 111  112     /// [API] 추적 옵션이 켜져 있으면 해당 단계·API의 시작을 콘솔에 출력한다. 113     static void trace(PipelineStage stage, const char* api) { 114         if (options().trace) 115             std::clog << "[OpenGL][" << stageName(stage) << "][" << api << "] 시작\n"; 116     } 117  118     /// [API] 현재 진단 문맥에서 원인·조치·객체 ID를 저장하고 출력한 뒤 false를 반환한다. 119     static bool fail( 120         PipelineStage stage, const char* api, const std::string& cause, 121         const std::string& action = "framework/docs/API_KO.md에서 해당 API의 입력 조건과 반환값을 확인하세요.", 122         std::optional<std::uint64_t> object = std::nullopt) { 123         issue() = Diagnostic{stage, api, cause, action, object}; 124         issue()->file = context().file; 125         issue()->line = context().line; 126         issue()->operation = context().operation; 127  128         if (options().errors) { 129             std::cerr << "[OpenGL][" << stageName(stage) << "][" << api << "] 오류"; 130  131             if (object) 132                 std::cerr << " 객체=" << *object; 133             std::cerr << ": " << cause << "\n  조치: " << action << '\n'; 134             std::cerr << "  소스: " << context().file << ':' << context().line 135                       << "\n  호출 경로: " << context().operation << '\n'; 136         } 137  138         return false; 139     } 140 }; 141 } // namespace graphics

   1 #pragma once   2 #include "Model.h"   3 #include <algorithm>   4 #include <map>   5 #include <numeric>   6 #include <stdexcept>   7    8 namespace graphics {   9 enum class UVMapping { Planar, Box, Cylindrical, Spherical };  10   11 struct UVOptions {  12     UVMapping mapping = UVMapping::Planar;  13     int axis = 2; // Planar projection drops X=0, Y=1, or Z=2.  14     glm::vec2 scale{1};  15     glm::vec2 offset{0};  16     float rotationDegrees = 0;  17 };  18   19 /// [API] 메시 UV에 배율→회전→이동을 적용한다. 회전 입력 단위는 도다.  20 inline bool transformTexcoords(Mesh& mesh, const glm::vec2& scale, const glm::vec2& offset, float rotationDegrees = 0) {  21     if (mesh.texcoords.size() != mesh.localVertices.size() || mesh.texcoords.empty() || !std::isfinite(scale.x) ||  22         !std::isfinite(scale.y) || !std::isfinite(offset.x) || !std::isfinite(offset.y) ||  23         !std::isfinite(rotationDegrees))  24         return false;  25   26     auto uvs = mesh.texcoords;  27     const double angle = glm::radians(double(rotationDegrees));  28     const double c = std::cos(angle), s = std::sin(angle);  29   30     for (auto& uv : uvs) {  31         const auto p = glm::dvec2(uv) * glm::dvec2(scale);  32   33         uv = glm::vec2(c * p.x - s * p.y, s * p.x + c * p.y) + offset;  34   35         if (!std::isfinite(uv.x) || !std::isfinite(uv.y))  36             return false;  37     }  38     mesh.texcoords = std::move(uvs);  39   40     return true;  41 }  42   43 /// [API] 평면·박스·원통·구 투영 옵션으로 메시 UV를 생성한다.  44 inline bool generateTexcoords(Mesh& mesh, const UVOptions& options = UVOptions{}) {  45     if (!detail::validMesh(mesh) || options.axis < 0 || options.axis > 2)  46         return false;  47   48     switch (options.mapping) {  49     case UVMapping::Planar:  50     case UVMapping::Box:  51     case UVMapping::Cylindrical:  52     case UVMapping::Spherical:  53         break;  54     default:  55         return false;  56     }  57   58     Mesh result = mesh;  59     glm::dvec3 low(mesh.localVertices[0]), high(low);  60   61     for (const auto& p : mesh.localVertices) {  62         low = glm::min(low, glm::dvec3(p));  63         high = glm::max(high, glm::dvec3(p));  64     }  65   66     const auto size = high - low, center = (low + high) * 0.5;  67     const double pi = std::acos(-1.0);  68     auto project = [&](std::uint32_t index, int axis) {  69         const auto p = glm::dvec3(mesh.localVertices[index]);  70   71         if (options.mapping == UVMapping::Planar || options.mapping == UVMapping::Box) {  72             const int u = axis == 0 ? 2 : 0, v = axis == 1 ? 2 : 1;  73   74             return glm::vec2(size[u] > 0 ? (p[u] - low[u]) / size[u] : 0.5,  75                              size[v] > 0 ? (p[v] - low[v]) / size[v] : 0.5);  76         }  77   78         const auto d = p - center;  79         const double radius = glm::length(d);  80   81         return glm::vec2(std::atan2(d.z, d.x) / (2 * pi) + 0.5,  82                          options.mapping == UVMapping::Spherical  83                              ? (radius > 0 ? std::asin(std::clamp(d.y / radius, -1.0, 1.0)) / pi + 0.5 : 0.5)  84                              : (size.y > 0 ? (p.y - low.y) / size.y : 0.5));  85     };  86   87     if (options.mapping == UVMapping::Planar) {  88         result.texcoords.clear();  89   90         for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < mesh.localVertices.size(); ++i)  91             result.texcoords.push_back(project(i, options.axis));  92     } else {  93         const auto indices = detail::triangles(mesh);  94   95         if (indices.size() > std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max())  96             return false;  97         result.localVertices.clear();  98         result.vertexNormals.clear();  99         result.vertexColors.clear(); 100         result.texcoords.clear(); 101         result.triangleIndices.clear(); 102         result.outlineIndices.clear(); 103         result.shape = GLFace::Mesh; 104  105         std::vector<std::uint32_t> first(mesh.localVertices.size(), std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()); 106  107         for (std::size_t t = 0; t < indices.size(); t += 3) { 108             const auto a = glm::dvec3(mesh.localVertices[indices[t]]); 109             const auto b = glm::dvec3(mesh.localVertices[indices[t + 1]]); 110             const auto d = glm::dvec3(mesh.localVertices[indices[t + 2]]); 111             const auto normal = glm::abs(glm::cross(b - a, d - a)); 112             const int axis = normal.x > normal.y ? (normal.x > normal.z ? 0 : 2) : (normal.y > normal.z ? 1 : 2); 113             std::array<glm::vec2, 3> uv{project(indices[t], axis), project(indices[t + 1], axis), 114                                         project(indices[t + 2], axis)}; 115  116             if (options.mapping != UVMapping::Box) { 117                 // Pole U is taken from neighboring corners, where longitude is defined. 118                 for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { 119                     const auto p = glm::dvec3(mesh.localVertices[indices[t + k]]) - center; 120  121                     if (p.x == 0 && p.z == 0) { 122                         const auto u = uv[(k + 1) % 3].x, v = uv[(k + 2) % 3].x; 123  124                         uv[k].x = (u + v + (std::abs(u - v) > 0.5f ? 1.0f : 0.0f)) * 0.5f; 125                     } 126                 } 127  128                 const float lo = std::min({uv[0].x, uv[1].x, uv[2].x}); 129                 const float hi = std::max({uv[0].x, uv[1].x, uv[2].x}); 130  131                 if (hi - lo > 0.5f) 132                     for (auto& p : uv) 133                         if (p.x < 0.5f) 134                             p.x += 1; 135             } 136  137             for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { 138                 const auto source = indices[t + k], target = std::uint32_t(result.localVertices.size()); 139  140                 if (first[source] == std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) 141                     first[source] = target; 142                 result.localVertices.push_back(mesh.localVertices[source]); 143  144                 if (!mesh.vertexNormals.empty()) 145                     result.vertexNormals.push_back(mesh.vertexNormals[source]); 146  147                 if (!mesh.vertexColors.empty()) 148                     result.vertexColors.push_back(mesh.vertexColors[source]); 149                 result.texcoords.push_back(uv[k]); 150                 result.triangleIndices.push_back(target); 151             } 152         } 153  154         for (auto index : mesh.outlineIndices) { 155             if (first[index] == std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()) { 156                 first[index] = std::uint32_t(result.localVertices.size()); 157                 result.localVertices.push_back(mesh.localVertices[index]); 158  159                 if (!mesh.vertexNormals.empty()) 160                     result.vertexNormals.push_back(mesh.vertexNormals[index]); 161  162                 if (!mesh.vertexColors.empty()) 163                     result.vertexColors.push_back(mesh.vertexColors[index]); 164                 result.texcoords.push_back(project(index, options.axis)); 165             } 166             result.outlineIndices.push_back(first[index]); 167         } 168     } 169  170     if (!transformTexcoords(result, options.scale, options.offset, options.rotationDegrees) || 171         !detail::validMesh(result)) 172         return false; 173     mesh = std::move(result); 174  175     return true; 176 } 177  178 /// [API] 메시의 삼각형 기하로 정점 법선을 다시 계산한다. 179 inline void recalculateNormals(Mesh& mesh) { 180     mesh.vertexNormals.assign(mesh.localVertices.size(), glm::vec3(0)); 181  182     const auto indices = detail::triangles(mesh); 183  184     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < indices.size(); i += 3) { 185         const auto a = indices[i], b = indices[i + 1], c = indices[i + 2]; 186         const auto n = 187             glm::cross(mesh.localVertices[b] - mesh.localVertices[a], mesh.localVertices[c] - mesh.localVertices[a]); 188  189         mesh.vertexNormals[a] += n; 190         mesh.vertexNormals[b] += n; 191         mesh.vertexNormals[c] += n; 192     } 193  194     for (auto& n : mesh.vertexNormals) { 195         const float size = glm::length(n); 196  197         n = size > 1e-12f ? n / size : glm::vec3(0); 198     } 199 } 200  201 // Weld equal positions for edge topology, while preserving separate UV/normal vertices. 202 /// [API] 메시의 윤곽 모드에 따라 선으로 그릴 정점 인덱스 쌍 목록을 계산한다. 203 inline std::vector<std::uint32_t> meshOutline(const Mesh& mesh, OutlineMode mode = OutlineMode::FeatureEdges) { 204     if (mode == OutlineMode::None) 205         return {}; 206  207     if (mode == OutlineMode::Explicit) 208         return mesh.outlineIndices; 209     using Position = std::array<float, 3>; 210  211     std::map<Position, std::uint32_t> points; 212     std::vector<std::uint32_t> welded; 213  214     for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < mesh.localVertices.size(); ++i) { 215         const auto& p = mesh.localVertices[i]; 216         const auto result = points.emplace(Position{p.x, p.y, p.z}, i); 217  218         welded.push_back(result.first->second); 219     } 220  221     struct Edge { 222         std::uint32_t a = 0, b = 0; 223         std::vector<glm::vec3> normals; 224     }; 225  226     std::map<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>, Edge> edges; 227     const auto indices = detail::triangles(mesh); 228  229     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < indices.size(); i += 3) { 230         const auto a = indices[i], b = indices[i + 1], c = indices[i + 2]; 231         auto normal = 232             glm::cross(mesh.localVertices[b] - mesh.localVertices[a], mesh.localVertices[c] - mesh.localVertices[a]); 233         const auto length = glm::length(normal); 234  235         if (length <= 1e-12f) 236             continue; 237         normal /= length; 238  239         const std::array<std::uint32_t, 3> corners{a, b, c}; 240  241         for (int e = 0; e < 3; ++e) { 242             auto first = welded[corners[e]], second = welded[corners[(e + 1) % 3]]; 243  244             if (first == second) 245                 continue; 246  247             if (first > second) 248                 std::swap(first, second); 249  250             auto& edge = edges[{first, second}]; 251  252             edge.a = first; 253             edge.b = second; 254             edge.normals.push_back(normal); 255         } 256     } 257  258     const float threshold = std::cos(glm::radians(mesh.creaseAngleDegrees)); 259     std::vector<std::uint32_t> result; 260  261     for (const auto& item : edges) { 262         const auto& edge = item.second; 263         const bool show = mode == OutlineMode::AllTriangleEdges || edge.normals.size() != 2 || 264                           glm::dot(edge.normals[0], edge.normals[1]) < threshold; 265  266         if (show) { 267             result.push_back(edge.a); 268             result.push_back(edge.b); 269         } 270     } 271  272     return result; 273 } 274  275 namespace detail { 276 // Ear clipping handles planar simple concave polygons, with either winding. 277 inline std::vector<std::uint32_t> triangulate(const std::vector<glm::vec3>& points) { 278     if (points.size() < 3) 279         throw std::runtime_error("Face has fewer than three corners."); 280  281     glm::vec3 normal(0); 282  283     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); ++i) { 284         const auto& a = points[i]; 285         const auto& b = points[(i + 1) % points.size()]; 286  287         normal += glm::vec3((a.y - b.y) * (a.z + b.z), (a.z - b.z) * (a.x + b.x), (a.x - b.x) * (a.y + b.y)); 288     } 289  290     if (glm::length(normal) < 1e-12f) 291         throw std::runtime_error("Degenerate polygon."); 292  293     const auto absNormal = glm::abs(normal); 294     const int axis = 295         absNormal.x > absNormal.y ? (absNormal.x > absNormal.z ? 0 : 2) : (absNormal.y > absNormal.z ? 1 : 2); 296     std::vector<glm::dvec2> projected; 297  298     for (const auto& p : points) 299         projected.push_back(axis == 0 ? glm::dvec2(p.y, p.z) : axis == 1 ? glm::dvec2(p.x, p.z) : glm::dvec2(p.x, p.y)); 300  301     double area = 0; 302  303     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < projected.size(); ++i) { 304         const auto& a = projected[i]; 305         const auto& b = projected[(i + 1) % projected.size()]; 306  307         area += a.x * b.y - b.x * a.y; 308     } 309  310     if (std::abs(area) < 1e-14) 311         throw std::runtime_error("Degenerate polygon projection."); 312  313     const double direction = area > 0 ? 1 : -1; 314     auto cross = [](glm::dvec2 a, glm::dvec2 b, glm::dvec2 c) { 315         return (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x); 316     }; 317  318     std::vector<std::uint32_t> polygon(points.size()), result; 319  320     std::iota(polygon.begin(), polygon.end(), 0); 321  322     while (polygon.size() > 3) { 323         bool clipped = false; 324  325         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < polygon.size(); ++i) { 326             const auto a = polygon[(i + polygon.size() - 1) % polygon.size()], b = polygon[i], 327                        c = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.size()]; 328  329             if (direction * cross(projected[a], projected[b], projected[c]) <= 1e-14) 330                 continue; 331  332             bool inside = false; 333  334             for (auto p : polygon) 335                 if (p != a && p != b && p != c && 336                     direction * cross(projected[a], projected[b], projected[p]) >= -1e-14 && 337                     direction * cross(projected[b], projected[c], projected[p]) >= -1e-14 && 338                     direction * cross(projected[c], projected[a], projected[p]) >= -1e-14) { 339                     inside = true; 340                     break; 341                 } 342  343             if (inside) 344                 continue; 345             result.insert(result.end(), {a, b, c}); 346             polygon.erase(polygon.begin() + i); 347             clipped = true; 348             break; 349         } 350  351         if (!clipped) 352             throw std::runtime_error("Cannot triangulate polygon; check repeated corners or self-intersections."); 353     } 354     result.insert(result.end(), polygon.begin(), polygon.end()); 355  356     return result; 357 } 358  359 inline void appendMesh(Mesh& destination, const Mesh& source) { 360     const auto first = std::uint32_t(destination.localVertices.size()); 361  362     destination.localVertices.insert(destination.localVertices.end(), source.localVertices.begin(), 363                                      source.localVertices.end()); 364     destination.vertexNormals.insert(destination.vertexNormals.end(), source.vertexNormals.begin(), 365                                      source.vertexNormals.end()); 366     destination.texcoords.insert(destination.texcoords.end(), source.texcoords.begin(), source.texcoords.end()); 367  368     for (auto i : triangles(source)) 369         destination.triangleIndices.push_back(first + i); 370     destination.shape = GLFace::Mesh; 371 } 372  373 inline bool shareEdge(const Mesh& a, const Mesh& b) { 374     const auto ae = meshOutline(a), be = meshOutline(b); 375  376     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ae.size(); i += 2) 377         for (std::size_t j = 0; j < be.size(); j += 2) { 378             const auto p = a.localVertices[ae[i]], q = a.localVertices[ae[i + 1]], r = b.localVertices[be[j]], 379                        s = b.localVertices[be[j + 1]]; 380  381             if ((p == r && q == s) || (p == s && q == r)) 382                 return true; 383         } 384  385     return false; 386 } 387  388 inline void mergeCoplanar(Model& model) { 389     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < model.faces.size(); ++i) { 390         auto& face = model.faces[i]; 391  392         if (glm::length(face.normal) < 1e-12f) 393             continue; 394  395         for (std::size_t j = i + 1; j < model.faces.size();) { 396             const auto& other = model.faces[j]; 397             const bool samePlane = 398                 glm::dot(face.normal, other.normal) > 1 - 1e-6f && 399                 std::abs(glm::dot(face.normal, other.localVertices[0] - face.localVertices[0])) < 1e-6f; 400  401             if (samePlane && face.texcoords.empty() == other.texcoords.empty() && shareEdge(face, other)) { 402                 appendMesh(face, other); 403                 model.faces.erase(model.faces.begin() + j); 404                 j = i + 1; 405             } else 406                 ++j; 407         } 408     } 409 } 410 } // namespace detail 411 } // namespace graphics

   1 #pragma once   2 #include "Transform.h"   3    4 namespace graphics {   5 // origin/extent are grid-local. frame converts grid-local coordinates to world.   6 struct GridLayout {   7     glm::vec3 origin{0}, extent{1};   8     glm::ivec3 cells{1};   9     glm::mat4 frame{1};  10   11     /// [API] origin·extent·셀 개수와 frame의 유한성·양수 크기·가역성을 검사한다.  12     bool valid() const {  13         const float determinant = glm::determinant(glm::mat3(frame));  14   15         return detail::finiteVector(origin) && detail::finiteVector(extent) && extent.x > 0 && extent.y > 0 &&  16                extent.z > 0 && cells.x > 0 && cells.y > 0 && cells.z > 0 && TransformSystem::validAffine(frame) &&  17                std::isfinite(determinant) && std::abs(determinant) > 1e-8f;  18     }  19   20     /// [API] [0,1] 비율을 origin+extent*ratio로 바꾼 뒤 frame으로 월드 위치를 계산한다.  21     std::optional<glm::vec3> position(const glm::vec3& ratio) const {  22         if (!valid() || !detail::finiteVector(ratio) || ratio.x < 0 || ratio.y < 0 || ratio.z < 0 || ratio.x > 1 ||  23             ratio.y > 1 || ratio.z > 1) {  24             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::position",  25                                 "Need a valid grid and ratios in [0,1].");  26   27             return {};  28         }  29   30         const auto result = glm::vec3(frame * glm::vec4(origin + extent * ratio, 1));  31   32         if (!detail::finiteVector(result)) {  33             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::position",  34                                 "Grid transformation overflow.");  35   36             return {};  37         }  38   39         return result;  40     }  41   42     /// [API] 0부터 시작하는 셀 인덱스를 해당 셀 중심의 월드 위치로 변환한다.  43     std::optional<glm::vec3> cellCenter(const glm::ivec3& index) const {  44         if (!valid() || index.x < 0 || index.y < 0 || index.z < 0 || index.x >= cells.x || index.y >= cells.y ||  45             index.z >= cells.z) {  46             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::cellCenter",  47                                 "Cell index is outside the grid.");  48   49             return {};  50         }  51   52         return position((glm::vec3(index) + glm::vec3(.5f)) / glm::vec3(cells));  53     }  54   55     /// [API] 양수 비율과 extent를 곱해 그리드 로컬 크기를 반환한다. frame 회전/배율은 적용하지 않는다.  56     std::optional<glm::vec3> relativeSize(const glm::vec3& ratio) const {  57         if (!valid() || !detail::finiteVector(ratio) || ratio.x <= 0 || ratio.y <= 0 || ratio.z <= 0) {  58             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::relativeSize",  59                                 "Need positive finite size ratios.");  60   61             return {};  62         }  63   64         const auto result = extent * ratio;  65   66         if (!detail::finiteVector(result)) {  67             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::relativeSize",  68                                 "Size overflow.");  69   70             return {};  71         }  72   73         return result; // Local dimensions. frame orientation is kept separate.  74     }  75   76     /// [API] 비율 위치를 월드로 계산한 뒤 parentWorld의 역행렬로 부모 로컬 위치를 반환한다.  77     std::optional<glm::vec3> positionInParent(const glm::vec3& ratio, const glm::mat4& parentWorld) const {  78         const auto world = position(ratio);  79         const float determinant = glm::determinant(glm::mat3(parentWorld));  80   81         if (!world || !TransformSystem::validAffine(parentWorld) || !std::isfinite(determinant) ||  82             std::abs(determinant) < 1e-8f) {  83             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::positionInParent",  84                                 "Parent transform must be finite, affine and invertible.");  85   86             return {};  87         }  88   89         const auto result = glm::vec3(glm::inverse(parentWorld) * glm::vec4(*world, 1));  90   91         if (!detail::finiteVector(result)) {  92             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::positionInParent",  93                                 "Parent inverse overflow.");  94   95             return {};  96         }  97   98         return result;  99     } 100  101     /// [API] 월드 점을 frame 역변환으로 그리드 셀 인덱스에 대응시킨다. 그리드 밖이면 빈 결과다. 102     std::optional<glm::ivec3> cellAt(const glm::vec3& world) const { 103         if (!valid() || !detail::finiteVector(world)) { 104             Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Transform, "GridLayout::cellAt", 105                                 "Invalid grid or world point."); 106  107             return {}; 108         } 109  110         const auto local = glm::vec3(glm::inverse(frame) * glm::vec4(world, 1)); 111         const auto ratio = (local - origin) / extent; 112  113         if (!detail::finiteVector(ratio) || ratio.x < 0 || ratio.y < 0 || ratio.z < 0 || ratio.x > 1 || ratio.y > 1 || 114             ratio.z > 1) 115             return {}; 261 } 262  263 inline glm::mat4 transformMatrix(const Transform3D& t) { 264     glm::mat4 m = glm::translate(glm::mat4(1), t.basis); 265  266     m *= glm::mat4(t.rotation); 267  268     return glm::translate(glm::scale(m, t.scale), -t.localBasis); 269 } 270  271 inline glm::mat4 faceMatrix(const Component_Poly& c, const Mesh& face) { 272     glm::mat4 child(1); 273  274     if (face.independence) { 275         // Rotate/scale around a face pivot without moving an identity child. 276         child = glm::translate(glm::mat4(1), face.transform.localBasis) * transformMatrix(face.transform); 277     } 278  279     return transformMatrix(c.transform) * child * face.localAnimationMatrix; 280 } 281 } // namespace detail 282 } // namespace graphics

"#flipped" : "#native"); 103  104         if (auto cached = imageCache_[key].lock()) 105             return cached; 106  107         auto image = std::make_shared<const TextureImage>(detail::decodeImage(full, nullptr, flip)); 108  109         imageCache_[key] = image; 110  111         return image; 112     } 113  114 public: 115     /// [API] 프로젝트 루트와 기능 옵션을 보관하고 상대경로 자산 로딩을 준비한다. 116     explicit AssetLoader(std::filesystem::path projectRoot = detail::executableDirectory(), 117                          FeatureOptions features = FeatureOptions{}) 118         : projectRoot_(std::filesystem::absolute(projectRoot)), features_(features) { 119     } 120  121     /// [API] 로더의 텍스처 등 기능 사용 옵션을 읽기 전용 참조로 반환한다. 122     const FeatureOptions& features() const { 123         return features_; 124     } 125  126     /// [API] 프로젝트 상대경로의 이미지를 읽어 TextureResult로 반환한다. 실패 원인은 error에 담는다. 127     TextureResult loadTexture(const std::filesystem::path& relative, bool flipRows = true) const { 128         try { 129             return {texture(relative, flipRows), {}}; 130         } catch (const std::exception& e) { 131             return {nullptr, e.what()}; 132         } 133     } 134  135     /// [API] 프로젝트 상대경로의 OBJ를 직접 파싱하여 모델·피벗·경고·오류 결과를 반환한다. 136     ModelResult loadObj(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options = LoadOptions{}) const; 137     /// [API] 기본 도형 OBJ를 읽는 호환 진입점이다. OBJ 로더로 처리를 위임한다. 138     ModelResult loadPrimitive(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options = LoadOptions{}) const; 139     /// [API] 모델 로딩 호환 진입점이다. 현재 구현은 loadObj로 위임하며 다른 형식 변환은 하지 않는다. 140     ModelResult loadModel(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options = LoadOptions{}) const; 141 }; 142 } // namespace graphics 143  144 namespace graphics { 145 /// [API] 모델 로딩 호환 진입점이다. 현재 구현은 loadObj로 위임하며 다른 형식 변환은 하지 않는다. 146 inline ModelResult AssetLoader::loadModel(const std::filesystem::path& relative, const LoadOptions& options) const { 147     return loadObj(relative, options); 148 } 149 } // namespace graphics

   1 #pragma once   2 #include "Graphics.h"   3    4 namespace graphics {   5 struct Ray {   6     glm::vec3 origin{0}, direction{0, 0, -1};   7     float maxDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();   8 };   9   10 struct PickResult {  11     EntityId entityId = 0;  12     std::size_t faceIndex = 0, triangleIndex = 0;  13     glm::vec3 worldPoint{0}, localPoint{0}, barycentric{0};  14     glm::vec2 uv{0};  15     bool hasUV = false;  16     float distance = 0; // Distance from ray origin (near plane for a screen ray).  17 };  18   19 struct PickViewport {  20     double x = 0, y = 0, width = 0, height = 0;  21 }; // top-left framebuffer pixels  22   23 /// [API] 왼쪽 위 기준 프레임버퍼 픽셀을 카메라 ray로 역투영한다. 영역 밖/잘못된 투영이면 빈 결과다.  24 inline std::optional<Ray> screenRay(const Camera& camera, double x, double y, const PickViewport& viewport) {  25     if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(camera) || !std::isfinite(x) || !std::isfinite(y) || !std::isfinite(viewport.x) ||  26         !std::isfinite(viewport.y) || !std::isfinite(viewport.width) || !std::isfinite(viewport.height) ||  27         viewport.width <= 0 || viewport.height <= 0 || x < viewport.x || y < viewport.y ||  28         x >= viewport.x + viewport.width || y >= viewport.y + viewport.height)  29         return {};  30   31     const auto pv = CameraSystem::projectionMatrix(camera, float(viewport.width / viewport.height)) *  32                     CameraSystem::viewMatrix(camera);  33     const auto determinant = glm::determinant(pv);  34   35     if (!std::isfinite(determinant) || std::abs(determinant) < 1e-12f)  36         return {};  37   38     const auto inverse = glm::inverse(pv);  39     const float nx = float(2 * (x - viewport.x) / viewport.width - 1),  40                 ny = float(1 - 2 * (y - viewport.y) / viewport.height);  41     auto nearPoint = inverse * glm::vec4(nx, ny, -1, 1), farPoint = inverse * glm::vec4(nx, ny, 1, 1);  42   43     if (std::abs(nearPoint.w) < 1e-12f || std::abs(farPoint.w) < 1e-12f)  44         return {};  45     nearPoint /= nearPoint.w;  46     farPoint /= farPoint.w;  47   48     const auto direction = glm::vec3(farPoint - nearPoint);  49     const auto length = glm::length(direction);  50   51     if (!detail::finiteVector(glm::vec3(nearPoint)) || !detail::finiteVector(direction) || !std::isfinite(length) ||  52         length <= 0)  53         return {};  54   55     return Ray{glm::vec3(nearPoint), direction / length, length};  56 }  57   58 /// [API] ray 또는 화면 좌표로 보이는 삼각형의 최근접 교차를 찾아 객체·면·위치·UV를 반환한다.  59 inline std::optional<PickResult> pick(const Scene& scene, const Ray& input) {  60     if (!detail::finiteVector(input.origin) || !detail::finiteVector(input.direction) ||  61         !std::isfinite(glm::length(input.direction)) || glm::length(input.direction) < 1e-12f ||  62         std::isnan(input.maxDistance) || input.maxDistance < 0)  63         return {};  64   65     const auto direction = glm::dvec3(glm::normalize(input.direction));  66     const auto origin = glm::dvec3(input.origin);  67     double nearest = input.maxDistance;  68     std::optional<PickResult> result;  69   70     for (auto id : scene.getIds()) {  71         const auto* component = scene.getComponent(id);  72   73         if (!component || !component->visible)  74             continue;  75   76         for (std::size_t f = 0; f < component->polyhedron.faces.size(); ++f) {  77             const auto& face = component->polyhedron.faces[f];  78   79             if (!face.visible)  80                 continue;  81   82             const auto world = scene.faceWorldMatrix(id, f);  83   84             if (!world)  85                 continue;  86   87             const auto matrix = *world;  88             const auto indices = detail::triangles(face);  89   90             for (std::size_t t = 0; t < indices.size(); t += 3) {  91                 const auto ia = indices[t], ib = indices[t + 1], ic = indices[t + 2];  92                 const auto a4 = matrix * glm::vec4(face.localVertices[ia], 1),  93                            b4 = matrix * glm::vec4(face.localVertices[ib], 1),  94                            c4 = matrix * glm::vec4(face.localVertices[ic], 1);  95   96                 if (std::abs(a4.w) < 1e-12f || std::abs(b4.w) < 1e-12f || std::abs(c4.w) < 1e-12f)  97                     continue;  98   99                 const auto a = glm::dvec3(a4 / a4.w), b = glm::dvec3(b4 / b4.w), c = glm::dvec3(c4 / c4.w); 100                 const auto edge1 = b - a, edge2 = c - a, p = glm::cross(direction, edge2); 101                 const auto determinant = glm::dot(edge1, p); 102                 const auto tolerance = 1e-12 * glm::length(edge1) * glm::length(edge2); 103  104                 if (!std::isfinite(determinant) || std::abs(determinant) <= tolerance) 105                     continue; 106  107                 const auto relative = origin - a; 108                 const auto u = glm::dot(relative, p) / determinant; 109  110                 if (u < 0 || u > 1) 111                     continue; 112  113                 const auto q = glm::cross(relative, edge1); 114                 const auto v = glm::dot(direction, q) / determinant; 115  116                 if (v < 0 || u + v > 1) 117                     continue; 118  119                 const auto distance = glm::dot(edge2, q) / determinant; 120  121                 if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance < 0 || distance > nearest) 122                     continue; 123  124                 const glm::dvec3 weights((1 - u - v) / a4.w, u / b4.w, v / c4.w); 125                 const auto sum = weights.x + weights.y + weights.z; 126  127                 if (std::abs(sum) < 1e-12) 128                     continue; 129  130                 PickResult hit; 131  132                 hit.entityId = id; 133                 hit.faceIndex = f; 134                 hit.triangleIndex = t / 3; 135                 hit.distance = float(distance); 136                 hit.worldPoint = glm::vec3(origin + direction * distance); 137                 hit.barycentric = glm::vec3(weights / sum); 138                 hit.localPoint = face.localVertices[ia] * hit.barycentric.x + 139                                  face.localVertices[ib] * hit.barycentric.y + 140                                  face.localVertices[ic] * hit.barycentric.z; 141                 hit.hasUV = !face.texcoords.empty(); 142  143                 if (hit.hasUV) 144                     hit.uv = face.texcoords[ia] * hit.barycentric.x + face.texcoords[ib] * hit.barycentric.y + 145                              face.texcoords[ic] * hit.barycentric.z; 146                 nearest = distance; 147                 result = hit; 148             } 149         } 150     } 151  152     return result; 153 } 154  155 /// [API] ray 또는 화면 좌표로 보이는 삼각형의 최근접 교차를 찾아 객체·면·위치·UV를 반환한다. 156 inline std::optional<PickResult> pick(const Scene& scene, const Camera& camera, double x, double y, 157                                       const PickViewport& viewport) { 158     const auto ray = screenRay(camera, x, y, viewport); 159  160     return ray ? pick(scene, *ray) : std::nullopt; 161 } 162 } // namespace graphics

 14   15     ~ComOwner() {  16         if (value)  17             value->Release();  18     }  19   20     ComOwner() = default;  21     ComOwner(const ComOwner&) = delete;  22   23     ComOwner& operator=(const ComOwner&) = delete;  24 };  25   26 inline void checkCom(HRESULT result) {  27     if (FAILED(result))  28         throw std::runtime_error("Image decoder failed (HRESULT " + std::to_string(result) + ").");  29 }  30   31 struct ComApartment {  32     HRESULT result = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);  33   34     ComApartment() {  35         if (result != RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE)  36             checkCom(result);  37     }  38   39     ~ComApartment() {  40         if (SUCCEEDED(result))  41             CoUninitialize();  42     }  43 };  44   45 inline TextureImage decodeImage(const std::filesystem::path& file, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>* encoded,  46                                 bool flipRows) {  47     ComApartment apartment;  48     ComOwner<IWICImagingFactory> factory;  49   50     checkCom(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory.value)));  51   52     ComOwner<IWICStream> stream;  53     ComOwner<IWICBitmapDecoder> decoder;  54   55     if (encoded) {  56         if (encoded->empty() || encoded->size() > std::numeric_limits<DWORD>::max())  57             throw std::runtime_error("Invalid encoded texture size.");  58         checkCom(factory.value->CreateStream(&stream.value));  59         checkCom(stream.value->InitializeFromMemory(const_cast<BYTE*>(encoded->data()), DWORD(encoded->size())));  60         checkCom(factory.value->CreateDecoderFromStream(stream.value, nullptr, WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnLoad,  61                                                         &decoder.value));  62     } else  63         checkCom(factory.value->CreateDecoderFromFilename(file.c_str(), nullptr, GENERIC_READ,  64                                                           WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnLoad, &decoder.value));  65   66     ComOwner<IWICBitmapFrameDecode> frame;  67     ComOwner<IWICFormatConverter> converter;  68   69     checkCom(decoder.value->GetFrame(0, &frame.value));  70     checkCom(factory.value->CreateFormatConverter(&converter.value));  71     checkCom(converter.value->Initialize(frame.value, GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppRGBA, WICBitmapDitherTypeNone, nullptr, 0,  72                                          WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom));  73   74     TextureImage image;  75   76     checkCom(converter.value->GetSize(&image.width, &image.height));  77   78     if (!image.width || !image.height || image.width > 16384 || image.height > 16384)  79         throw std::runtime_error("Texture dimensions must be within 1..16384.");  80     image.rgba.resize(std::size_t(image.width) * image.height * 4);  81     checkCom(converter.value->CopyPixels(nullptr, image.width * 4, UINT(image.rgba.size()), image.rgba.data()));  82   83     if (flipRows) {  84         const std::size_t stride = std::size_t(image.width) * 4;  85   86         for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < image.height / 2; ++y)  87             std::swap_ranges(image.rgba.begin() + y * stride, image.rgba.begin() + (y + 1) * stride,  88                              image.rgba.begin() + (image.height - 1 - y) * stride);  89     }  90   91     return image;  92 }  93 } // namespace detail  94 } // namespace graphics

114     } 115  116     if (key == GLFW_KEY_A) { 117         body_.direction = {-1, 0, 0}; 118         walking_ = true; 119     } 120  121     if (key == GLFW_KEY_D) { 122         body_.direction = {1, 0, 0}; " 열기\n" : " 원상복귀\n"); 141     } 142  143     if (key == GLFW_KEY_SPACE) 144         walking_ = !walking_; 145  146     if (key == GLFW_KEY_J) 147         graphics::CollisionSystem::jump(body_, 5.5f); 148  149     if (key == GLFW_KEY_I) 150         require(initScene(), "실습 23 초기화 실패: 앞선 API 오류를 확인하세요."); 151  152     if (key == GLFW_KEY_Q || key == GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) 153         app_.requestClose(); 154 } 155  156 void Console::onUpdate(float dt) { 157     const float requested = body_.speed; 158  159     if (!walking_) 160         body_.speed = 0; 161  162     const auto result = graphics::CollisionSystem::stepCharacter(body_, bounds_, obstacles_, dt); 163  164     body_.speed = requested; 165     require(result.has_value(), "실습 23 캐릭터 충돌 계산 실패."); 166  167     const float yaw = glm::degrees(std::atan2(body_.direction.x, body_.direction.z)); 168  169     require(graphics::PatternSystem::poseWalkingRig(app_.getScene(), rig_, body_.feet, yaw, body_.walkDistance, 170                                                     body_.speed), 171             "실습 23 로봇 관절 자세 적용 실패."); 172  173     for (std::size_t face = 0; face < doors_.size(); ++face) { 174         doors_[face] = std::clamp(doors_[face] + (open_[face] ? 1.0f : -1.0f) * dt, 0.0f, 1.0f); 175         require(graphics::PatternSystem::openRoomWall(app_.getScene(), stage_, face, doors_[face]), 176                 "실습 23 벽 개방·복원 실패."); 177     } 178  179     if (activeWall_ && !open_[*activeWall_] && doors_[*activeWall_] == 0) 180         activeWall_.reset(); 181 }

510  511     if (!track) 512         return false; 513     animation_.push_back(*track); 514  515     const auto control = [&](graphics::EntityId id, const std::string& name) { 516         std::size_t index = 0; 517  518         while (index < animation_.size() && animation_[index].joint != id) 519             ++index; 520  521         if (index == animation_.size()) { 522             auto fixed = graphics::AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation(scene, id, graphics::Motion{}); 523  524             if (!fixed) 525                 return false; 526             animation_.push_back(*fixed); 527         } 528         jointControls_.push_back({index, name, animation_[index].rest}); 529  530         return true; 531     }; 532  533     const auto personControls = [&](const graphics::HumanoidRig& rig, const std::string& prefix) { 534         if (!control(rig.root, prefix + " root") || !control(rig.pelvis, prefix + " pelvis") || 535             !control(rig.torso, prefix + " torso") || !control(rig.neck, prefix + " neck")) 536             return false; 537  538         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) { 539             const auto side = prefix + (i == 0 ? " left " : " right "); 540  541             if (!control(rig.shoulders[i], side + "shoulder") || !control(rig.elbows[i], side + "elbow") || 542                 !control(rig.hands[i], side + "hand") || !control(rig.hips[i], side + "hip") || 543                 !control(rig.knees[i], side + "knee") || !control(rig.feet[i], side + "foot")) 544                 return false; 545         } 546  547         return true; 548     }; 549  550     if (!control(swing->frame, "swing frame") || !control(swing->hinge, "swing hinge") || 551         !control(swing->seat, "swing seat") || !personControls(swing->person, "rider") || 552         !personControls(*person, "standing")) 553         return false; 554     app_.getCamera() = graphics::Camera{}; 555     app_.getCamera().position = {8, 5, 10}; 556     app_.getCamera().target = {0, 1.4f, 0}; 557     std::cout << "9: 노란 상자는 4초 편도 선형보간, 그네는 3초 주기 진자, 좌석의 사람은 계층 변환을 따릅니다.\n"; 558     printSelectedJoint(); 559  560     return graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(scene, animation_, 0); 561 } 562  563 /// 선택한 관절의 기준 자세를 편집하고 같은 시각의 애니메이션에 반영한다. 564 bool Console::handleJointKey(int key) { 565     if (jointControls_.empty()) 566         return false; 567  568     if (key == GLFW_KEY_TAB) 569         selectedJoint_ = (selectedJoint_ + 1) % jointControls_.size(); 570     else if (key == GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE) 571         selectedJoint_ = (selectedJoint_ + jointControls_.size() - 1) % jointControls_.size(); 572     else if (key == GLFW_KEY_X || key == GLFW_KEY_Y || key == GLFW_KEY_Z) 573         selectedAxis_ = key == GLFW_KEY_X ? 0 : key == GLFW_KEY_Y ? 1 : 2; 574     else { 575         auto& track = animation_[jointControls_[selectedJoint_].track]; 576         const auto saved = track.rest; 577  578         if (key == GLFW_KEY_LEFT || key == GLFW_KEY_RIGHT) { 579             glm::vec3 axis(0); 580  581             axis[selectedAxis_] = 1; 582             track.rest.rotation = 583                 track.rest.rotation * 584                 glm::mat3(glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), glm::radians(key == GLFW_KEY_LEFT ? -5.0f : 5.0f), axis)); 585         } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_UP || key == GLFW_KEY_DOWN) 586             track.rest.basis[selectedAxis_] += key == GLFW_KEY_UP ? .05f : -.05f; 587         else if (key == GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP || key == GLFW_KEY_PAGE_DOWN) 588             track.rest.localBasis[selectedAxis_] += key == GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP ? .05f : -.05f; 589         else if (key == GLFW_KEY_EQUAL || key == GLFW_KEY_KP_ADD || key == GLFW_KEY_MINUS || 590                  key == GLFW_KEY_KP_SUBTRACT) { 591             const bool grow = key == GLFW_KEY_EQUAL || key == GLFW_KEY_KP_ADD; 592  593             track.rest.scale = glm::vec3(std::clamp(track.rest.scale.x * (grow ? 1.1f : 1 / 1.1f), .1f, 3.0f)); 594         } else if (key == GLFW_KEY_R) 595             track.rest = jointControls_[selectedJoint_].initialRest; 596         else 597             return false; 598  599         if (!graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(app_.getScene(), animation_, clock_.seconds)) { 600             track.rest = saved; 601             std::cerr << "관절 편집 거절: 기준 자세를 복원했습니다.\n"; 602         } 603     } 604     printSelectedJoint(); 605  606     return true; 607 } 608  609 /// 선택 관절·축·이동·피벗·균일 배율을 출력한다. 610 void Console::printSelectedJoint() const { 611     if (jointControls_.empty()) 612         return; 613  614     const auto& control = jointControls_[selectedJoint_]; 615     const auto& rest = animation_[control.track].rest; 616  617     std::cout << "joint " << selectedJoint_ + 1 << '/' << jointControls_.size() << ": " << control.name 618               << " axis=" << "XYZ"[selectedAxis_] << " position=" << rest.basis.x << ',' << rest.basis.y << ',' 619               << rest.basis.z << " pivot=" << rest.localBasis.x << ',' << rest.localBasis.y << ',' << rest.localBasis.z 620               << " scale=" << rest.scale.x << '\n'; 621 } 622  623 /// 프레임 시간으로 상태와 장면을 갱신한다. 624 void Console::onUpdate(float dt) { 625     if (demo_ == Demo::Motion || !clock_.playing) 626         return; 627  628     if (!clock_.advance(dt)) { 629         app_.requestClose(); 630  631         return; 632     } 633  634     auto& scene = app_.getScene(); 635     bool ok = true; 636  637     if (demo_ == Demo::Animation) { 638         ok = graphics::AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(scene, animation_, clock_.seconds); 639     } else if (demo_ == Demo::Grid) { 640         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < gridBoxes_.size(); ++i) 641             ok = graphics::PatternSystem::follow(scene, gridBoxes_[i], distancePath_, 642                                                  clock_.seconds + distancePath_.length() * i / 5) && 643                  ok; 644     } else { 645         const float angle = .4f * float(std::sin(clock_.seconds)); 646         const auto matrix = glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1), angle, glm::vec3(0, 0, 1)); 647         graphics::Transform3D roomTransform; 648  649         roomTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(matrix); 650         roomTransform.basis = glm::vec3(matrix * glm::vec4(0, .5f, 0, 1)); 651         ok = 652             scene.setTransform(room_, roomTransform) && scene.setFaceVisible(room_, 5, !floorOpen_) && 653             graphics::CollisionSystem::stepRoomBody(roomBody_, {{-2, -1, -2}, {2, 2, 2}}, matrix, dt, floorOpen_, false, 654                                                     {0, -9.8f, 0}, {0, 0, .4f * float(std::cos(clock_.seconds))}); 655  656         graphics::Transform3D cubeTransform; 657  658         cubeTransform.basis = roomBody_.position(matrix); 659  660         if (!roomBody_.released) 661             cubeTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(matrix); 662         ok = scene.setTransform(roomCube_, cubeTransform) && ok; 663     } 664  665     if (!ok) 666         app_.requestClose(); 667 } 668  669 /// 현재 장면을 지정한 뷰로 렌더링한다. 670 bool Console::onRender() { 671     if (!threeViews_) 672         return app_.renderScene(); 673  674     const auto size = app_.getFramebufferSize(); 675  676     if (size[0] < 3 || size[1] < 2) 677         return true; 678  679     return app_.renderViews( 680         graphics::PatternSystem::threeViews(app_.getCamera(), size[0], size[1], app_.getRenderOptions())); 681 }

   1 #include "Console.h"   2    3 /// 콜백을 등록하고 애플리케이션을 실행한다.   4 int main() {   5     graphics::Application app;   6     Console sample(app);   7    8     app.setInitHandler([&](graphics::Application&) {   9         return sample.initScene();  10     });  11     app.setKeyHandler([&](graphics::Application&, int key, int action) {  12         sample.onKey(key, action);  13     });  14     app.setMouseHandler([&](graphics::Application&, const graphics::MouseEvent& event) {  15         sample.onMouse(event);  16     });  17     app.setUpdateHandler([&](graphics::Application&, float dt) {  18         sample.onUpdate(dt);  19     });  20     app.setRenderHandler([&](graphics::Application&) {  21         return sample.onRender();  22     });  23   24     graphics::ApplicationConfig config;  25   26     config.title = "standard - Motion, Grid, diagnostics and render passes";  27   28     return app.run(config);  29 }
소스와 graphify AST/정의 앵커를 대조한 학습 자료다. 실행 순서 설명은 실제 콜백 코드로 보완했다. 그래프의 동명 심볼·함수 포인터 간선은 확정 호출로 해석하지 않는다. 빌드·실행·테스트·검증기·브라우저 시각 확인은 수행하지 않았고 사용자에게 맡긴다. ZIP을 만들지 않았다.
